confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Swiss and Ticino price levels for July 2026. Not checked against live listings or booking pages. Hotel and hostel anchors are the least certain because summer demand moves them. Restaurant anchors are more stable. The FX observation came from a search-result summary that attributes the figure to the RBA exchange-rates overview page. I did not open that page, so the as_of_date and source_rate should be verified against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Swiss tourist towns with Ticino price levels (for example Locarno and Bellinzona) and on Swiss national restaurant and lodging price levels. Lugano is set slightly below Zurich and Geneva for restaurants and hotels because it is a smaller resort city.
